JObj lookups 5 and 9 are retained as joints carrying the required left and right car splines; lookups 12 through 16 are retained separately. Camera and blast-zone edges are reduced by the current camera offset and stored as eight relative values. The stage light list is traversed, every encountered point light is hidden, and the last point light is retained in x110 for recurring attenuation updates.
